title: In Basket coverage: Omar and Aysha
changes: Added Omar Al-Shuwaykh and Aysha Aslam as a new two-physician group in In Basket Podlet Coverage.

title: Desktop Medicine: Phase I pharmacy refill support
changes: Phase I pharmacy refill support went live October 14. Pharmacy may renew eligible GI prescriptions with no refills remaining within the medication-specific limits of the working agreement.

The Desktop Medicine reference covers monitoring requirements, refill limits, exclusions, and when Pharmacy routes a case back to the prescribing provider. Providers remain responsible for reviewing results and deciding whether therapy continues.

title: Pathology result workflow
changes: Added the MD-MA QuickAction protocol for colonoscopy, EGD, and combined EGD/colonoscopy (TURN) pathology results under Orientation → MA-MD → Messages & Result Notes.
The reference covers MD QuickAction setup and routing to the MA inbox, MA result letters and dotphrases, and the MD’s responsibility to update PROMPT with the surveillance interval.

title: OR scheduling and peritoneal dialysis
changes: Clarified that dysautonomia risk is an additional reason for OR scheduling in patients with quadriplegia.

Clarified the rationale for booking peritoneal-dialysis cases at Antioch: Walnut Creek has only three admit bays, limiting its ability to accommodate pre-procedure antibiotics that take over 60 minutes.
In booking comments, state “Patient is on peritoneal dialysis” so schedulers recognize that the case is restricted to Antioch.
